context: The input is nums = [4, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2], with indices 0 through 5. The pass starts at the left end and moves right, comparing two neighbors at a time. Swap them if the left element > the right element. Leave them in place if the left element ≤ the right element.

The elements appear as a row of round bubbles. Larger values have larger bubbles. The left end represents the bottom of the water and the right end the surface. A pale green box marks the pair being compared. Curved arrows above and below the bubbles inside the box indicate that the pair has just been swapped.
description: Steps 2 through 6 compare five successive pairs of neighbors and show the result after each comparison or swap. Step 7 identifies the position now fixed and the range left for later passes.

frames.announcement: The six unsorted elements [4, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2] appear as bubbles, ready for comparison from left to right.
frames.explanation: The six bubbles above correspond to nums = [4, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2] below, at indices 0 through 5. Bubble volume is proportional to element value. No comparisons have been made, and all six elements await this pass.
frames.key_state: Initially, nums = [4, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2]. The six bubbles are in their original order.
frames.title: Represent the array as a row of bubbles

frames.announcement: The 4 at index 0 exceeds the 1 at index 1. Swapping them moves 4 to index 1.
frames.explanation: At indices 0 and 1, 4 > 1. Swap them, moving 4 to index 1. The pale green box now contains [1, 4], and the arcs show the completed swap. Now nums = [1, 4, 3, 1, 5, 2], and the scan has reached index 1.
frames.key_state: Swapping 4 and 1 at indices 0 and 1 gives [1, 4, 3, 1, 5, 2].
frames.title: Compare and swap indices 0 and 1

frames.announcement: The 4 at index 1 exceeds the 3 at index 2. Swapping them moves 4 to index 2.
frames.explanation: At indices 1 and 2, 4 > 3. Swap them, moving 4 to index 2. The pale green box now contains [3, 4]. Now nums = [1, 3, 4, 1, 5, 2], and the scan has reached index 2.
frames.key_state: Swapping 4 and 3 at indices 1 and 2 gives [1, 3, 4, 1, 5, 2].
frames.title: Compare and swap indices 1 and 2

frames.announcement: The 4 at index 2 exceeds the 1 at index 3. Swapping them moves 4 to index 3.
frames.explanation: At indices 2 and 3, 4 exceeds the 1 on its right (the second 1 in the original array). Swap them, moving 4 to index 3. The pale green box now contains [1, 4]. Now nums = [1, 3, 1, 4, 5, 2], and the scan has reached index 3.
frames.key_state: Swapping 4 and the second 1 at indices 2 and 3 gives [1, 3, 1, 4, 5, 2].
frames.title: Compare and swap indices 2 and 3

frames.announcement: The 4 at index 3 is less than or equal to the 5 at index 4. Leave them in place.
frames.explanation: At indices 3 and 4, 4 ≤ 5, so the elements stay in place. The box contains [4, 5] with no swap arcs. Now nums = [1, 3, 1, 4, 5, 2], and the scan has reached index 4. Next, compare 5 with its right neighbor.
frames.key_state: At indices 3 and 4, 4 ≤ 5. No swap occurs, and the array remains [1, 3, 1, 4, 5, 2].
frames.title: Compare indices 3 and 4 and leave them in place

frames.announcement: The 5 at index 4 exceeds the 2 at index 5. Swapping them moves the largest element, 5, to the far right.
frames.explanation: At indices 4 and 5, 5 > 2. Swap them. The pale green box now contains [2, 5], with the maximum, 5, at index 5. Now nums = [1, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5]. All five pairs of neighbors have been compared.
frames.key_state: Swapping 5 and 2 at indices 4 and 5 places the maximum, 5, at index 5. The array is [1, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5].
frames.title: Compare and swap indices 4 and 5

frames.announcement: The first pass is complete. The maximum, 5, is at the far right, and the first five elements remain to be sorted.
frames.explanation: The pass ends with nums = [1, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5]. The largest bubble, 5 at index 5, crosses the vertical surface marker and turns gray to show its position is final. A brace below marks the remaining range [0, 4] on the left, toward the bottom of the water. Its values [1, 3, 1, 4, 2] await later passes.
frames.key_state: The pass is complete. The maximum, 5, is at index 5. The remaining unsorted range [0, 4] contains [1, 3, 1, 4, 2].
frames.title: The maximum, 5, is in place

summary: Compare adjacent elements from left to right. One pass moves the maximum, 5, to the right end.
title: One bubble sort pass
